title: Amordle physical keyboard navigation

direct.label: Menu
direct.description: Open or close the main navigation menu.

patterns.label: Move focus
patterns.description: Move forward or backward through available controls.

patterns.label: Activate
patterns.description: Activate the focused button, link, tab, or menu item.

patterns.label: Close
patterns.description: Close the topmost menu or dialog and return focus to its trigger.

patterns.label: Enter a letter
patterns.description: Type into the active game. Shift + M is reserved for the global Menu shortcut.

patterns.label: Delete
patterns.description: Remove the final letter from the current guess.

patterns.label: Move within a control
patterns.description: Move through tabs, radio groups, menus, listboxes, and supported grids.

rules: Global Shift shortcuts do not run while typing in a text field, textarea, select, editable region, or modal dialog.
Plain letters and numbers keep their ordinary meaning.
Touch and pointer controls remain fully supported; physical-keyboard navigation is optional.
